exports.nanogptTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.nanogptSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createNanogptTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.createNanogptSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxTranscriptBytes } for tests
exports.buildNanogptSpeechRequest: (model, text, options) -> source speech body; throws status 400
exports.buildNanogptTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body: FormData, responseFormat } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.matchesContainer: (container, bytes) leading-byte check for mp3, opus (Ogg), aac (ADTS/ADIF), flac, wav
exports.nanogptAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.NANOGPT_AUDIO_DEFINITION: audio fields to merge into the existing nanogpt registry entry (addServiceKinds, ttsConfig, sttConfig)
exports.NANOGPT_STT_MODELS: transcription models with per-model response formats
exports.NANOGPT_SPEECH_RESPONSE_FORMATS: containers plus "ogg" (alias of opus) and "json" (gateway wrapper)
exports.nanogptDocumentedTtsAdapter: documented-format TTS adapter instance (adds pcm); the one registration puts in TTS_ADAPTERS
exports.nanogptDocumentedSttAdapter: documented-format STT adapter instance (adds srt and vtt for whisper-1); the one the sttCore nanogpt branch calls
exports.createNanogptDocumentedTtsAdapter: factory; same options as createNanogptTtsAdapter, accepts pcm
exports.createNanogptDocumentedSttAdapter: factory; same options as createNanogptSttAdapter, per-model formats from NANOGPT_DOCUMENTED_STT_MODELS
exports.NANOGPT_DOCUMENTED_STT_MODELS: transcription models with every vendor-documented response format
exports.checkNanogptPcm: (bytes, contentType) -> { pcm: layout } or { error }; container magic, document and whole-frame checks
exports.NANOGPT_PCM_DEFAULTS: s16le, 16-bit, 24000 Hz, mono (OpenAI pcm layout; NanoGPT names tts-1/tts-1-hd as OpenAI models)

models.voiceSuffix: tts model/voice accepted; default voice alloy
models.dynamicDiscovery: none for audio: the source lists the nanogpt audio models statically; the existing modelsFetcher (https://nano-gpt.com/api/v1/models) is the chat catalog and stays as is

speech.body: { model, input, voice, response_format, speed, instructions? }
speech.answer: audio bytes in the requested container, or raw pcm (documented adapter)

transcription.body: model, language?, prompt?, response_format?, temperature?, timestamp_granularities[]*, file
transcription.answer: json / verbose_json object with text, text/plain, or srt / vtt subtitles (documented adapter, whisper-1)

sources.omniroute: c71f0065a7efe9230ec23b96a12253b050c4d7ad open-sse/handlers/audioSpeech.ts default branch sends normalizeSpeechResponseFormat(body.response_format) (any lower-cased value, ogg -> opus); open-sse/handlers/audioTranscription.ts default branch forwards any response_format and timestamp_granularities[] and passes the answer through; no nanogpt-specific format list
sources.speechDocs: https://docs.nano-gpt.com/api-reference/endpoint/speech.md: 'Audio Format Support by Provider' lists OpenAI (tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts) response_format mp3 (default), opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm; streaming Content-Type list includes audio/pcm
sources.sttCatalog: GET https://nano-gpt.com/api/v1/audio-models?type=stt (public): whisper-1 supported_parameters.response_formats [json, text, verbose_json, srt, vtt], timestamp_granularities [segment, word], feature 'Subtitle format support (SRT, VTT)'; no gpt-4o-transcription row (gpt-4o-mini-transcribe* rows list json only)
sources.sttDocs: https://docs.nano-gpt.com/api-reference/endpoint/audio-transcriptions.md documents no response_format values; https://docs.nano-gpt.com/api-reference/endpoint/transcribe.md documents diarize as 'Enable speaker diarization (Elevenlabs-STT only)' on the async /api/transcribe workflow

tts.pcm: tts-1, tts-1-hd; raw bytes checked for no container magic, no JSON/HTML document, whole 16-bit frames; answer type audio/pcm, octet-stream or none; layout s16le 24000 Hz mono unless audio/pcm names rate/channels
